contract_deviations: Drift check runs after stage_infra + stage_schema when in run set (not strictly 'top of main()'); rationale: pipeline_watermarks lives in Postgres brought up by stage_infra and created by stage_schema. Argparse validation still fires at the top. --skip-drift-check escape hatch added.
Added --methods and --workers CLI args to run_e2e (not in dispatch literal, but required to forward through to run_matrix for AC-2 and to match T-20 evidence pattern).
--bronze default changed from hardcoded 'data/bronze/raw_states' to per-source resolution (synthetic -> data/bronze/synthetic, else raw_states).
under_specification_resolved: '--source choices' - dispatch mentioned s3|zenodo|rest|synthetic but run_e2e only had zenodo|live. Expanded to {zenodo, live, s3, rest, synthetic}. stage_ingest refuses s3/rest/synthetic with actionable argparse error.

'live mapping' - run_matrix does not know 'live'; when --source=live is combined with stage_matrix, matrix_source falls back to 'zenodo' AND argparse requires --ym (because mapped source is in REAL_SOURCES). Without this guard, run_matrix would reject the invocation mid-run. Preserves pre-T-22 behavior where stage_matrix always hardcoded zenodo, but now with fail-fast validation.
'sink requires calendar ym' - synthetic sink would be meaningless (postgres_sink DDL CHECK rejects SYN-*). Added explicit argparse-layer rejection when 'sink' is in run and --ym is missing or SYN-*.

'drift check sat_state_observation' - dispatch spec enumerates 4 tables (hub_flight, link_flight_aircraft, link_flight_route, sat_flight_summary); vault_io.PARTITIONED_TABLES has sat_state_observation too. Followed dispatch; flagged in RISKS for T-24 review.
unblocks: T-24 (data-engineer review of PR5 run_e2e wiring)
risks_known_limits: stage_ingest refuses s3/rest/synthetic (ingest_runner.py only knows zenodo|live|replay). Operator must use --only / --skip ingest.

Drift check uses broad `except Exception` wrapping into informative SystemExit referencing --skip-drift-check. Real OperationalError / UndefinedTable is still surfaced in the message; not silently swallowed.

Postgres must be reachable for every run unless --skip-drift-check is passed. Pre-T-22 synthetic matrix-only could run without Postgres (T-20 evidence). Change is per dispatch spec; --skip-drift-check escape hatch documented in --help.
VAULT_PARTITIONED_TABLES is the 4-table subset per dispatch; sat_state_observation is NOT in the drift check. Intentional per spec but worth confirming in T-24.
No change to stage_eval_mart (operates across all months per dispatch); it continues to read pipeline_runs globally.
